name: Personal journaling app with iOS Shortcuts authoring and Go server rendering

mentions.name: Personal journaling app with iOS Shortcuts authoring and Go server rendering
mentions.description: A personal journaling program where entries are written entirely through iOS Shortcuts — the only functions are creating a new entry, or creating a new entry with a photo and metadata taken from that photo. Rendering of the journal is handled by a Go server, which the builder wrote as an excuse to learn Go.
mentions.problem: There was no existing journaling program the builder liked.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I realized that there is no journaling program I like, so I wrote my own. Authoring is done purely by iOS shortcuts and is writer (the only thing I want is to create a new entry, or create a new entry with a photo and metadata from said photo)

Rendering is done by a go server. I wanted to learn go for quite a while and this is the perfect excuse.
